tasks.title: Implement deny-by-default PermissionPolicy
acceptance_criteria: PermissionPolicy resolves repo_root/worktree and rejects any path escaping it via .. or symlinks by resolving before containment checks
read_file/list_files allowed only inside repo_root minus forbidden patterns; write_file additionally requires the resolved path to be inside an explicit allowed write scope, empty by default
Forbidden path patterns include at least: .env, .env.*, .git/, .ssh/, *.pem, *.key, id_rsa, id_ed25519, .venv/, __pycache__/, *.egg-info/, node_modules/, dist/, build/
run_shell is denied unless shell_enabled=True and the command's argv matches an explicit allowlist, which is empty by default
An always-deny set (rm, mv, chmod, chown, sudo, curl, wget, ssh, scp, git push, git merge, git commit, open, osascript) is enforced ahead of and regardless of the allowlist
Commands are represented as argv lists, never shell strings; nothing in this module calls subprocess with shell=True or at all

validation_results.summary: Imports cleanly. Exercised in a real temp dir: read/list allowed inside repo_root; both a `..` traversal and a symlink pointing outside repo_root are denied (resolve-before-check catches both); all 6 representative forbidden patterns denied (.env, .git/config, id_rsa, a.pem, __pycache__/x.pyc, pkg.egg-info/PKG-INFO); write allowed only inside the explicit allowed_write_scope subdir, denied elsewhere in repo_root and denied on a forbidden-pattern path. Shell: denied by default, denied when enabled but not allowlisted, allowed when enabled+allowlisted, and 5 always-deny commands (rm, git commit, sudo, curl, git push) denied even when explicitly present in the allowlist. grep confirmed zero subprocess usage in the module (docstring mention only).

tasks.title: Implement filesystem local tools

A denied path returns a ToolResult with ok=False and a clear reason instead of raising or performing the disk access

validation_results.summary: Imports cleanly. Exercised in a temp dir: read_file succeeds on an allowed path and returns exact content; denied on a forbidden pattern (.env) and on a .. traversal attempt, both returning ok=False with a reason instead of raising or touching disk. write_file succeeds inside the allowed write scope (file verified on disk) and is denied (file confirmed NOT created) when allowed_write_scope is empty. list_files returns the directory's entries. Missing required tool_call argument returns a clear ok=False error instead of a KeyError.

tasks.title: Implement run_shell local tool
acceptance_criteria: RunShellTool implements LocalTool

validation_results.summary: Imports cleanly. Verified via mock.patch('subprocess.run', side_effect=AssertionError) that subprocess.run is never invoked on two deny paths: shell disabled by default, and an always-deny command (rm) present in an explicit allowlist. Verified an allowed command (echo, enabled+allowlisted) actually runs and returns its real stdout. Verified a 0.2s timeout on `sleep 3` is enforced and returns ok=False. grep confirms the only shell= usage in the file is the literal shell=False call. Invalid argv shape (a string instead of a list) is rejected before any policy check.
